name: Jena Climate: Weather Station Time Series Benchmark
description: The Jena Climate dataset is a high-resolution meteorological time series recorded at the Max Planck Institute for Biogeochemistry weather station in Jena, Germany. Recording 14 atmospheric variables every 10 minutes from 2003 to the present—including air temperature, atmospheric pressure, relative humidity, vapor pressure, dew point temperature, wind speed, and wind direction—the dataset serves as a canonical benchmark for recurrent neural networks, LSTMs, and deep learning time series forecasting.
